name: Firefly Sunset Resort
primary_cta: Villa and price check on screen 1: villa + arrival + nights, total with 10% VAT, then Request to book (that villa's Guesty page with checkIn/checkOut/minOccupancy) or email
brand_truth: Villas on the Sea of Abaco named for things that glow and fly, rebuilt after Dorian, where the day is measured by the sunset from your deck.
buyer: Affluent US families and couples, honeymooners and boaters booking a week in Hope Town; locals and visitors for the Bar & Grill.

direction.why: Excellent 1920 px photography needs almost no interface; the hero tells you live when the sun sets over the Sea of Abaco tonight; conch pink is the deck at sunset, shutter green the one action colour.

tier_why: Photography, a live sunset clock computed for Hope Town, and a price check with VAT; no 3D.
concept_type: booking: six villas with published rates and VAT, request-to-book handing off to Guesty, dinner to Tablein

changes_applied: hero card compact and low-right so pool and sun stay visible; phone crop keeps the sun
screens varied: offset photo pair with caption, split Bar & Grill with hours as type, full-bleed dock with the amenities line set into it
villa check as one ruled list with a sticky price panel, Mint To Be and a March week selected so a total shows at once
night photo behind the calling card closes the sunset story

critic_note: Final critic not run (plan-gate workflow); self-critique done. qa craft note: h1 is only 1.9x body by design (quiet luxury card).
current_site_findings: page titles read <title> Villas in Google and tabs
homepage slider shows Slide title / Button placeholders over Pexels stock
no phone number on the site
rates and the booking rule buried at the bottom of the villas page
pitch_line: Tonight's sunset time, live, over your own plunge-pool photograph; then a guest picks a villa and dates, sees the total with VAT, and lands on your own request-to-book page.
assumptions: weekly rate applied per full 7 nights, extra nights at the daily rate
season by arrival month; holiday window treated as Nov 25-29 and Dec 20-Jan 2 and quoted on request
Irvin House has no published rate
photo 114 read as the rebuilt dock and deck; gallery photos otherwise unlabelled
notes: 2026-11-22 jobspec rebuild: design.md written first; price check moved into screen 1 beside the plunge-pool photo; villas index with sticky resort-from-water photo; four-step ferry route; whole-resort switch and conch groups screen.
Decision: their site has no per-villa photographs, so the villa picker is typographic and no gallery frame is attributed to a specific villa.

Decision: Guesty checkIn/checkOut/minOccupancy URL parameters are a best-effort handoff; the resort calendar confirms. Holiday windows (Wed before Thanksgiving to the Sunday after, Dec 20 to Jan 2) are our reading of their excluded holidays; quote says ask.
